guard_cases: drawn back at a saved scroll, the page is laid out whole

long_task_after.harness_enter_task_ms: none over 50 in most runs, worst 53-54 with the CPU profiler attached under sibling load

root_cause: Not a re-render or data transform. React work on Enter was about 20 ms. The rest was the cold first layout forced by the stage's land() focus of the arriving topic page (a warm relayout of the same page takes 4 ms): (1) the hero badge's U+2922 glyph, missing from Segoe UI, ran the font-fallback search (25-30 ms); (2) cold layout of the sections under the hero (about 27 ms).
deviations_from_card: The fix is not a split, defer or memo of JS. It removes a font-fallback glyph (now an inline SVG) and defers the layout of the sections under the hero on a fresh open (content-visibility: auto behind data-fresh). Rejected after measuring: content-visibility on the hero too (moved a 67-83 ms task into the rendering frame), and retiming stage/land() (F3's surface, shared by every scene, would not shorten the layout). ADR 0224 records the decision.
notes: Measured with ATHENA_BROWSER set to Chrome while siblings were building (about 40 node/chrome processes): perf:chores still passed 6 of 6 with no long task at all, so no quiet-tree re-run was needed. A quiet-tree confirmation by the coordinator is welcome. First paint is untouched: chores is lazy, and the change sits in topic.tsx and chores.css only. Did not touch stage/.
